answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the lantern check immediately, the forge audit keeps the resolved set and the kernel replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 215 aliases thus pays the reading cost 215 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
